description: Fallback infobox for a subject that has no suitable specialized infobox. Reuse the existing ten semantic rows before introducing a new template.
documentation_wikitext:
__NOTOC__
Fallback infobox for a subject that has no suitable specialized infobox. Reuse the existing ten semantic rows before introducing a new template.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Infobox subject|name=Example|header1=Section|subheader2=Subsection|label3=Label|data3=Value|disclosure4=Details|data4=[[Milady Maker|Content]]|below=Footer}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Use a specialized infobox when it fits the subject. Values accept wikitext, including links, lists and inline citations; image fields take a native filename and alt fields take plain text. Empty rows are omitted. Use only information appropriate for a concise, sourced summary.

Ten numbered rows support headers, subheaders, label/data pairs and collapsible disclosures. For each row, header takes precedence over subheader, then disclosure and ordinary data. Use image_content for a rendered component. The presentation and accent fields select the existing visual variants.

examples.description: A miscellaneous subject expressed through stable fields and one labeled custom row.
examples.invocation:
{{Infobox subject
| name = Example tool
| type = Software tool
| date = 2024
| status = Active
| label1 = Platform
| data1 = Web
| website = [https://example.org Official website]
}}
